diagnosis: The customer support chat namespace automatically emits the complete message history of a ticket to any socket that connects to the dynamic namespace path without authenticating the socket or checking ticket ownership. Any client who connects to a predictable or enumerated ticket namespace can read private customer conversations and confidential account issues.
